items.en_title: Santa Rita de Caldas (MG) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 19 #19
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Santa Rita de Caldas (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 399,250; proposals close Nov 19, 14:16 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
